test.summary: Global - Tempo Integration - Automatic Tempo Synchronization

steps.action: Navigate to Jira User management and check if such a user already exists, if not then create a new user
steps.result: New user is created and visable on the list of Jira users.

steps.action: Navigate to Tempo->Teams and create a new team
steps.result: Team is created and visable on the list of teams.

steps.action: Click on team and add member
steps.result: User is available on the list

steps.action: Navigate to Tempo->Settings->Staff/Roles and create a new role
steps.result: Role is created and visable on the list of roles.

steps.action: Navigate to Tempo->Settings->Staff/Workload and create a new workload
steps.result: Workload is created and visable on the list of workloads.

steps.action: Navigate to Tempo->Settings->Staff/Holidays and create a new holiday
steps.result: Holiday is created and visable on the list of holidays.

steps.action: Navigate to App Configuration->Intergations->Tempo->Synchronization tab
steps.result:
Tempo intergation tab is displayed.

Automatic Tempo Synchronization switcher is off.

Save button is displayed.

steps.action:
Switch on the 
Automatic Tempo Synchronization switcher.
steps.result:
Automatic Tempo Synchronization switcher is green.

Additional options are displayed:
- Indiviudals
- Workload plans
- Holiday plans
- Skills
- Teams


Synchronization time field is displayed.
Placeholder in the field says "e.g. 0 0 * * * (every day at midnight, 12 am)"

Save button is disabled.

steps.action: Check the Workload plans checkbox
steps.result: Workload plans checkbox is selected.

steps.action: In Synchronization time field type a cronExpression and click Save
steps.data:
cronExpression: use a cron expression that set automatic synchronization time in next few minutes.
For example cron expression "20 * * * *" will activate sync with Tempo 20 minutes past every hour.

More examples here: https://crontab.guru/
steps.result: Setting is successfully saved.

steps.action: Switch the tab to API tokens and go back to Tempo -> Synchronization tab
steps.result: Automatic Tempo Synchronization button is green and active

steps.action: Wait till scheduled synchronization time and navigate to Administration->Resources->Workload Plans
steps.result:
Workload Plans tab is displayed.

Workload plan TC-2877 with lozenge "Tempo" is on the list.

steps.action: Navigate to App Configuration->Intergations->Tempo
steps.result:
Tempo intergation tab is displayed.

Workload plans checkbox is selected.

Save button is displayed.

CronExpression is displayed in the field Scynchronization time.

steps.action: Check the Holiday plans checkbox
steps.result: Holiday plans and Workload plns  checkboxs are selected.

steps.action: In Synchronization time field type a new cronExpression and click Save
steps.data:
cronExpression: use a cron expression that set automatic synchronization time in next few minutes.
For example cron expression "10 14 * * *" will activate sync with Tempo every day at 14:10.

More examples here: [https://crontab.guru/|https://crontab.guru/]
steps.result: Setting is successfully saved.

steps.action: Wait till scheduled synchronization time and navigate to Administration->Resources->Holiday Plans
steps.result:
Holiday Plans tab is displayed.

Holiday plan TC-2877 with lozenge "Tempo" is on the list.

steps.action: Navigate to App Configuration->Intergations->Tempo
steps.result:
Tempo intergation tab is displayed.

Workload plans and Holiday Plans checkbox are selected.

Save button is displayed.

CronExpression is displayed in the field Scynchronization time.

steps.action:
Check the Skills checkbox
Click on the Save buttton
steps.result: Skills, Holiday plans and Workload plns checkboxs are selected.

steps.action: Wait till scheduled synchronization time and navigate to Administration->Resources->Skills
steps.result:
Skills tab is displayed.

Skill TC-2877 with Tempo Sync Status - Synced is on the list.

steps.action: Navigate to App Configuration->Intergations->Tempo
steps.result:
Tempo intergation tab is displayed.

Skills, Workload plans and Holiday Plans checkbox are selected.

Save button is displayed.

CronExpression is displayed in the field Scynchronization time.

steps.action:
Check the Individuals checkbox
Click on the Save button

steps.action: Wait till scheduled synchronization time and navigate to Administration->Resources->Individuals
steps.result:
Individuals tab is displayed.

User TC-2877 with Tempo Sync Status - Synced is on the list.

steps.action: Navigate to App Configuration->Intergations->Tempo
steps.result:
Tempo intergation tab is displayed.

Individuals, Skills, Workload plans and Holiday Plans checkbox are selected.

Save button is displayed.

steps.action:
Check the Teams checkbox
Click on the Save button

steps.result:
